subject: GreenWave: Intermittent inference failures after private cutover - NAT/MTU investigation
messages:
From: Marta Sánchez <marta.sanchez@greenwave.health>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom@equicloud.io>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Production inference 502s after private cutover - packet capture attached

Hi Aisha,

We completed the private deployment cutover this morning (~07:30 PST). Since then we have been seeing intermittent 502/connection reset errors from our inference calls to the Redwood private endpoint. The errors look like this: short-lived 502s, then successful requests, different clients affected.

Attached is a short packet capture from one failed request (greenwave_sample.pcap). Traceroutes from our side show the path flips between the EquiCloud crossconnect and Redwood's on-prem gateway. We also noticed 1472-byte ICMP fragmentation-needed messages coming back at times, and some sessions that never establish the return TCP handshake.

Can you advise next steps? This is impacting latency-sensitive clinical flows—we're throttling some traffic but need a fix.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Sánchez
SRE Lead, GreenWave Health

Subject: Re: Production inference 502s after private cutover - initial triage findings

Quick findings from the pcap and control-plane checks:
- The pcap shows repeated SYN retransmits from GreenWave client -> Redwood, then an ICMP "fragmentation needed" message with mtu=1420 on the path back. After that, the client drops and we see incomplete 3-way handshakes.
- On the on-prem NAT box (10.12.44.1) conntrack table is at ~98% and ephemeral SNAT ports are high (many short-lived flows from multiple GreenWave hosts). SNAT pool size currently configured to 16k ports per egress IP; with the cutover traffic pattern the effective available ports per client IP are smaller.
- Firewall logs show occasional TCP RST/Rejects but not at a volume to account for all failures. More likely path MTU + conntrack exhaustion combination.

Recommended immediate mitigations (short term):
1) Temporarily increase SNAT ephemeral port pool and add a second SNAT IP to reduce collisions. I'll prepare a small config snippet (snat_pool_snapshot.txt).
2) Enable MSS clamping at the edge (target egress interfaces) to force TCP MSS ~1380 so we avoid fragmentation when intermediate MTU=1420.
3) Confirm EquiCloud crossconnect has jumbo/MTU settings and whether they're doing any inner-encapsulation that reduces effective MTU. Tom, can you confirm encapsulation (GRE/VXLAN) on your side?

I'll try the SNAT increase in staging and report within the hour.

-Dev
Senior Network Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production inference 502s after private cutover - additional datapoints

Fyi I pulled BGP and interface stats from the crossconnect and the on-prem edge:
- Minor BGP flap recorded at 07:28 coincident with cutover (neighbor flapped for ~12s) — routes re-advertised but next-hops switched between two aggregation devices for a short window.
- Interface counters indicate occasional 'too-long' fragments dropped on the aggregation switch; MTU mismatch between EquiCloud peer and our edge likely (we see 1500 configured on peer, but an 18-byte inner-encap on their side reduces effective path MTU).
- Security group/stateful firewall rules: our edge device is currently enforcing a restrictive ephemeral port whitelist for GreenWave's /27; some clients behind their NAT use source ports outside expected range causing state misses on return.

Proposal:
- Short-term (today): add a second SNAT IP, increase conntrack timeout for short flows, enable MSS clamp to 1380 on egress.
- Medium-term: update crossconnect MTU alignment with EquiCloud to account for inner-encapsulation, and relax SG ephemeral port expectations to a broader range (1024-65535) for the GreenWave subnet.

I'll prepare the exact CLI steps. Chloe — if you can coordinate the maintenance window with Tom and Marta, let's aim for a 30-min slot this afternoon.

Marcus
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Production inference 502s after private cutover - schedule and playbook

Thanks team — concise plan and responsibilities below. I created JIRA INF-4321 for the mitigation run (link in thread).

Playbook (30 min maintenance)
- T+0: Apply extra SNAT IP and reload SNAT map (Dev) — expect <1 min transient flows.
- T+5: Enable MSS clamp (Marcus) on egress interfaces at 1380; monitor for fragmentation-needed messages.
- T+10: Temporarily relax SG ephemeral port restrictions for GreenWave subnet (Neha) and increase conntrack timeout to 120s (Dev).
- T+15: EquiCloud validation: Tom to confirm encapsulation settings and bump peer MTU or adjust encapsulation to avoid >1420 effective payloads.
- T+20: Smoke test with GreenWave (Marta) — run 50 parallel inference calls for 5 minutes; monitor for 502s.
- T+30: Rollback plan ready if errors increase.

Marta/Tom — can you confirm availability for a 30-min window at 15:00 PST today? If yes we'll proceed and I will post status updates to the Jira ticket.
